title: ir.posture.changed
description: A principal's posture moved. Pushes an immediate binding revocation for that principal (decision D2/D10). direction is derivable from from/to but included explicitly so consumers can assert the ratchet without re-deriving it: an automated change must have direction=tighten; direction=loosen is valid only when approved_by is present (Trust Architecture §6.4).

approved_by.description: Required when direction=loosen and to_posture is restricted or quarantined being relaxed by more than the automatic watch-to-normal decay (Trust Architecture §6.4). Null for automated tightening and for the policy-set automatic watch-to-normal decay.
